title: A Comprehensive Study of Native Code Bugs in Python Applications
abstract: arXiv:2608.29851v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The impact of Python applications has been evidenced by their widespread presence in some of the most impactful software domains, such as machine learning frameworks and scientific computing platforms. These applications often integrate native code components written in a lower-level programming language like C. This multilingual construction brings various benefits such as greater performance efficiency and easier interoperability with diverse runtime environments. However, bugs in the native code (i.e., native code bugs), which are usually stealthy, also constitute a major additional challenge to the quality of the Python applications as a whole. Yet despite existing relevant studies, there remains a lack of comprehensive understanding of native code bugs in Python applications. translated_title: Python应用中原生代码缺陷的全面研究
translated_abstract: Python应用程序的影响力已通过其在一些最具影响力的软件领域中的广泛存在得到证实，例如机器学习框架和科学计算平台。这些应用程序通常集成了用较低级编程语言（如C语言）编写的原生代码组件。这种多语言构建方式带来了诸多好处，例如更高的性能效率以及与多样化运行时环境更便捷的互操作性。然而，原生代码中的缺陷（即原生代码缺陷）通常较为隐蔽，也对Python应用程序的整体质量构成了额外的重大挑战。尽管已有相关研究，但对Python应用程序中原生代码缺陷仍缺乏全面的理解。本文旨在通过首次对此类缺陷的深入研究来弥补这一知识空白，剖析其常见症状、引入位置等特征（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 本文首次对Python应用中的原生代码缺陷进行了深入的全面研究，剖析了此类缺陷的常见症状、引入位置等特征，填补了Python多语言应用质量研究领域的知识空白。
en_tdlr: This paper presents the first in-depth comprehensive study of native code bugs in Python applications, dissecting their common symptoms and introduction locations to fill the knowledge gap in understanding this multilingual software quality challenge.
